d: A FreeSewing pattern for a bomber or letterman jacket

s.bustWarning.t: The bust dart won't be generated
s.bustWarning.d: Chest is smaller than high bust. If these measurements are accurate, you don't need a bust dart.
s.waistWarning.t: The bust dart won't be generated
s.waistWarning.d:
HPS to waist front is smaller than HPS to waist back.
Did you take the HPS to waist front measurement down over the bust?
s.armLiningDistance.t: The sleeve lining is identical to the sleeve piece.
s.armLiningDistance.d: Because of the angle of the lining armscye adjustment, there's no extra length on the sleeve lining curve for this pattern. Trace the **sleeve** (3) to cut out the **sleeve lining** (13) from the lining material.
s.cutFrontLining.t: The front lining is not shown.
s.cutFrontLining.d: The **front lining** (11) is not shown, but you can trace it from the Front part (1), which has the lining boundary on it (not including seam allowance).
s.cutBackLining.t: The back lining is not shown.
s.cutBackLining.d: The **back lining** (12) is not shown, but you can trace it from the Back part (2), which has the lining boundary on it (not including seam allowance). The back lining extends further at the center than the back piece itself.
s.expandSplitBack.t: The back and yoke are drawn together.
s.expandSplitBack.d: The **back** (3) and **yoke** (4) are drawn together as a single piece. Trace the two halves split at the horizontal boundary (not including seam allowance). Note that the back lining piece (12) extends further at the center back than the back or yoke.

hipsEase.d: The amount of ease at your hips

ribbingHeight.d: Controls the height of the ribbing

ribbingStretch.d: Use this to adapt the pattern to how stretchy the ribbing that you are using is.

bustDart.d:
Draft the pattern with a full bust adjustment and a bust dart. This only takes effect if Draft for High Bust is true.
This option isn't guaranteed to preserve the armhole or side seam lengths. Proceed with caution.

fullBustEase.d: Allows you to independently control the ease in the bust adjustment without affecting the armscye

bustDartHeight.d: Where to place the bust dart on the side seam. Only used if the code can't automatically find an intersection on the side seam

sideCutAngle.d: Tweaks the angle of the dart for the full bust adjustment

dartLegsTruing.d: This option tweaks the side seam to keep the bust dart legs the same length.

dartLegsTruingNo.d: Don't adjust the dart leg lengths

bustDartOffset.d: How close to the bust apex to start the bust dart

pocketCornerOffset.d: How close to the corner do you want the pocket to start

ribbing.d: Whether to generate a waistband and cuffs made of stretchy ribbing

ribbingYes.d: Use ribbing for waistband and cuffs

ribbingNo.d: Do not use ribbing for waistband and cuffs

ribbingEndsPercentage.d: How wide to make the button placket extension at the ends of the waistband

neckShiftForward.d: Cut the neck lower in the front than Brian's default neckline, by this percentage of the neck measurement

yokesplit.d: How tall to make the yoke

ribbedCollarWidth.d: How wide to make the ribbed collar

ribbedCollarCurve.d: How far the ends of the ribbed collar curve

closureCount.d: How many buttons or snaps to use. The last one goes on the waistband extension

yoke.d: Whether to draft the back panel with a yoke across the shoulders. The yoke does no extra shaping right now, so this doesn't affect the fit.

waistEase.d: The amount of ease at the waist

placketwidth.d: How wide to make the button placket, as a percentage of the chest measurement

useBellyAdjustment.d: This widens the front piece to account for a waist wider than the hip measurement. To use this, make sure to take the waist measurement at the fullest part of your belly

bellyAdjustmentX.d: Determines the horizontal placement of the belly adjustment

armCutAngle.d: This applies only to the rotation-based implementation. Tweak this if the armhole looks wrong.

frontWeltPockets.d: Determines whether to draft the pattern with diagonal welt pockets on the front

pocketBottomX.d: Horizontal position of the bottom of the pocket

pocketBottomY.d: Vertical position of the bottom of the pocket

pocketTopX.d: Horizontal position of the top of the pocket

pocketTopY.d: Vertical position of the top of the pocket

pocketWeltWidth.d: How wide to make the pocket welt piece

armholeShiftAngle.d: The angle at which to add some extra space to the armscye of the lining

centerPleatWidth.d: How much extra space to add to the center back of the lining in a pleat

liningArmscyeShift.d: How much extra space to add to the armscye of the lining
